invariants.rationale: The method returns a HoodieWriteMetadata object assigned in all paths.
executor is passed to the method and used without null checks.
table is used to obtain the active timeline and transition state, indicating it must be non-null.
writeStatuses is provided to updateIndexAndMaybeRunPreCommitValidations and must be non-null.
Option types are expected to be non-null or present, by usage of orElseGet.
